$schema_note: Live values that hs_game_sdk.skill_sliders_model is checked against (tests/test_skill_sliders_model.py, MeasuredTests); the mechanism is docs/models/skill-sliders-spec.md and the research is ForgePact/docs/skill-sliders-research.md (## Live 1). Rows come from ForgePact#160's three live sessions of 2026-10-04 (research build, `projprobe`, Sorak, slot 14, a White Mage); `capture` names the session's local operator capture (a gitignored hub workorder file) and `dll_sha256` the research DLL. The rows from `slider-amount-shadowbolt-off` on come from the implementation workorder's two live sessions of the same day (the shipped `skillslider` on the development build of ForgePact's 160-mod-skill-sliders branch, no `projprobe`), `dll_sha256` that DLL; a lever there may be a `slider_*` function of the test, and an `inconclusive` row may also be a read taken outside any check. Each row: `id`, `kind` (baseline or target), `status` (only `measured` rows are checked; `inconclusive` rows record values whose check the procedure left not-run), `date`, `source[]` ({`path`, `section`}), `scripts[]` (hs-game-sdk GameScript names), `what`, `values`, and optionally `model`: {`function`, `args`, `observed`, `lever`, `tolerance`}, the skill_sliders_model function the row checks, its keyword arguments (a number, or a string such as "35/12" passed to Fraction as is), the value the game showed, the research lever applied to the function's result as an input transform (`{transform, value}`, a projprobe_* function of the test), and the absolute tolerance for a value the capture printed rounded to six decimals.

source.section: ### 7.6 Projectile count, projectile speed and AoE size

measurements.what: Live 2 amount-count-baseline: three single Shadow Bolt casts, each with ReturnExtraSpellProjectiles called with a base of 1 and returning 1, each left one White_Mage_Shadow_Bolt_obj (skillstate's instance count read 1, and 0 before each cast).

source.section: ### 7.6 Projectile count, projectile speed and AoE size

measurements.what: Live 2 amount-count-boost: with `projprobe amount 2` the first boosted line read `1 -> 3` and two single Shadow Bolt casts left 3 bolts each. A double cast left 7 (the player's call, base 2 that time, returned 4; the double-cast proc's, base 1, returned 3); it has no same-class baseline and is not checked here.

source.section: ### 7.6 Projectile count, projectile speed and AoE size

measurements.what: Live 3 spurn-boost and aoe-ids: with `projprobe aoe 50`, stat 554 read 50 under LoadAllModifiers (0 at baseline) and the new White_Mage_Soul_Spurn_AOE_obj's projEffect[1086] read 0.5 (0 at baseline); the boosted Mana Orb read 0.5 too. So on this path the net factor is 1 on 0.01 per point. How LoadAllModifiers scales 554 was not read.

source.section: ### 7.6 Projectile count, projectile speed and AoE size

measurements.what: Live 3 spurn-baseline: two single Soul Spurn casts, each a new White_Mage_Soul_Spurn_AOE_obj with image_xscale = image_yscale = 7.5, maxScale 0 and projEffect[1086] 0.

source.section: ### 7.6 Projectile count, projectile speed and AoE size

measurements.what: Live 3 spurn-boost: with `projprobe aoe 50` (first boosted line `0 -> 50` after the cast) a new single-cast Soul Spurn object read projEffect[1086] 0.5 and image_xscale = image_yscale = 8.0, against 7.5 at baseline; maxScale stayed 0 and viewSize read 544. The skill object's parent event adds element 1086 to both image scales when maxScale is 0, the arithmetic projectile_scale models.

Live 3 orb-boost, left not-run by the procedure: the boosted Mana Orb was a single cast and both written baselines were double casts (1.15 on both scales). The boosted object read 1.65 on both scales and projEffect[1086] 0.5, and a supplementary single-cast baseline outside the procedure read 1.15.

source.section: ### 7.6 Projectile count, projectile speed and AoE size

measurements.what: Live 3 hz-modifiers (and Live 2 aoe-obj-boost): with `projprobe aoe 50` stat 554 read 50, but the new White_Mage_Healing_Zone_obj's projEffect[1086] read 0, maxScale 3 and image_xscale 1.5, as at baseline. The modifier list does not reach the zone, whose own step clamps its scale to 1.5. No model call: the model covers what element 1086 does, not which objects receive it.

source.section: ### 7.6 Projectile count, projectile speed and AoE size

measurements.what: Live 2 speed-skill-baseline: two new White_Mage_Shadow_Bolt_obj read deltaSpeed 2.916667 (printed to six decimals; the boosted rows below match exactly with 35/12). Stats 74 and 75 read 0 under LoadAllModifiers on this character (Live 1 speed-ids). The speed built-in read 2.625 and 2.919840, deltaSpeed times the object's deltaTimer (0.9 and 1.001088).

source.section: ### 7.6 Projectile count, projectile speed and AoE size

measurements.what: Live 2 speed-skill-boost: `projprobe speed stat 75 add 0.5` raised stat 75 from 0 to 0.5 inside LoadAllModifiers (first boosted `0 -> 0.5`, statApplied=1); the new bolt read deltaSpeed 2.931250, x1.005. The percent element is the stat times 0.01 (stored_speed_elements' percent_scale 1/100); stat 74 was 0, so the order does not matter here.

measurements.what: Live 2 speed-skill-boost: `projprobe speed stat 74 add 0.5` (first boosted `0 -> 0.5`); the new bolt read deltaSpeed 3.125000, +0.208333. source.section: ### 7.6 Projectile count, projectile speed and AoE size

measurements.what: Implementation Live 1 on-speed: `skillslider projspeed 50`; the lever's line read `first=0->50 skip=0` (stat 75 as ReturnSpecificStat returned it inside the player's LoadAllModifiers, 0 on Sorak, raised to 50) and two new bolts read deltaSpeed 4.375000, x1.5. No lever in the model call: MeasuredTests applies a lever to the function's result, which here is deltaSpeed, not stat 75, so the slider's output is folded into percent_element (slider_speed(0, 50) at the measured 0.01 per point, the research rows above), as the projprobe rows do.

source.section: ### 7.6 Projectile count, projectile speed and AoE size

measurements.what: Implementation Live 1 scope-other: levers at 2/50/50 in Outskirts of Inoya (Act_01_01), no input for about 60 s beside enemies and the mercenary. The speed lever counted 7 other LoadAllModifiers calls, the last from Mercenary_obj, and left them unchanged; the amount and AoE levers counted no other caller. No other caller named Player_obj or Universal_Double_Cast_obj; no enemy object was named (the enemies died within the first seconds). The speed lever's own= also rose 13 -> 17 -> 18 with no cast: Player_obj calls LoadAllModifiers outside a cast (around the zone change and while idle; what triggers it was not read).

source.section: ### 7.6 Projectile count, projectile speed and AoE size

measurements.what: Implementation Live 2 vanilla-baseline: eight single Shadow Bolt casts with no lever ever armed in that launch counted 1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 3, 2, 1 (the largest of `hs_skill_cast`'s effect_after and five `skillstate` reads each). The count is the number of White_Mage_Shadow_Bolt_obj instances, so whatever else makes a bolt counts too; what made the extra ones (a double cast, an item proc) was not read. After a lever went back to 0, the first casts of four transitions counted 1, 1, 2, 1 and the twelve later ones 1 or 2, every slider counter unchanged across them. No model call: the model gives one cast's helper total, not this variance.

Implementation Live 1, a read outside any check: right after the at-max Q cast (aoesize 100) one White_Mage_Shadow_Bolt_obj read image_xscale 1.75, and right after the first cast at +0 (off-restored) one read 0.75. One read each, so the Shadow Bolt object taking element 1086 like Soul Spurn (0.75 + 1.0) is a supporting read, not a measurement.
